faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Research Associate position at IIM Bangalore?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Research Associate - Jal Jeevan Mission post at IIM Bangalore is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application is completed before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.A, M.A, M.S, or M.Phil in Economics. Additionally, strong communication, analytical, and research skills are essential for this role.

faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Research Associate - Jal Jeevan Mission at IIM Bangalore.

faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided link on the official website on or before the last date of application.

faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment for the Senior Research Associate position at IIM Bangalore.

faq.answer: Excellent oral and written communication, mature attitude, knowledge of data sources and collection methods, proficiency in MS Office, and familiarity with statistical tools are crucial.
